description: Without arguments: shows Rove credit prices and whether this key may buy. With item_id: buys that credit pack and may charge the account owner's saved card, or returns a payment link for a person, within limits the owner set. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying the same purchase. Without idempotency_key, the same call again in this MCP session returns the first purchase for 10 to 20 minutes; to buy the same pack twice on purpose, pass a new idempotency_key each time.

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency_key an earlier buy_credits result returned, to retry that same purchase. Use a new one for a new purchase. 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -

item_id.description: A pack id from top_ups or get_credit_catalogue, e.g. pack_1k. Omit it to see prices without buying.

payment.description: auto (default): charge the saved card when the owner allowed it, else return a payment link for a person; checkout: always a payment link; saved_method: only the saved card.

name: buy_credits
title: Buy credits
